'''Unar''' was a member of the [[Imperial Diplomatic Service]] that served as the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire's]] [[Ambassador/Legends|ambassador]] to the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]] and its leader, [[Supreme Mogul]] [[Karagga]] the Unyielding. When Karagga began to [[Annexation of neutral systems|expand]] [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]], he [[Death/Legends|executed]] Unar as a way of severing ties with the Empire. Ambassador [[Rove (Ambassador)|Rove]] was appointed in Unar's place.<ref name="SWTOR" />
